options.description: Open problems are listed before fixed ones, and the pane updates as the register changes while it is open. Recommended: Open problems are the ones that need attention, so listing them first and keeping the pane current matches the aim of catching recurrences; the owner's words only asked for a collapsible, navigable pane with information.
options.label: Open first, pane refreshes (Recommended)

options.description: The pane lists problems in register order and shows a snapshot; it does not change until reopened.
options.label: Plain order, no refresh
